scenario: restoration 与 teardown：冷启动、后台/前台、scene 重连和 disconnect 始终留在 Babel2；每次 teardown 都取消 Babel2 root 的 observer/task/callback
environment: Xcode 27.0 / iOS 27.0 SDK; iPhone 17 Simulator, UDID 555E35FA-6BFE-45F0-BCFC-0819FFE48CD2; Debug executable SHA-256 f937ceb39b8579565a7efa17e0044099046ce29e36ab640e34a89c6a7f4f642a; PID 60005 throughout

command_or_steps: App already foregrounded from A8 run, in Daring Fireball article list (session 28542900-7A0B-47F5-8467-F6E30B412785, PID 60005). Screenshot 1-foreground.png.

`xcrun simctl launch <udid> com.apple.Preferences` — brings Settings to foreground, which pushes Babel2 to background without terminating it. Screenshot 2-backgrounded-settings-visible.png confirms Settings is now the visible app.

`log show --last 15s --info` during the transition shows real UIKit lifecycle events for the Babel2 process (Deactivation reason added, applicationWillResignActive) — the transition genuinely happened, not a no-op capture.

`xcrun simctl launch <udid> com.wenbopan.NetNewsWire.iOS-DEBUG` again — this brings Babel2 back to foreground. `simctl launch` on an already-running app activates it rather than relaunching the process.
Screenshot 3-foreground-again.png; `log show --last 15s --info` for the return transition.

observed.same_process: PID stayed 60005 across the entire background→foreground round trip — this was never a process relaunch, confirming the exact same AppDelegate/Babel2LaunchTraceRecorder instance survived.
observed.real_lifecycle_callbacks_fired: `Application processing resumed.` (from AppDelegate.resumeIfNecessary, called by SceneDelegate.sceneWillEnterForeground) appears in the log at 12:44:19.393, immediately after the relaunch — this is a real callback firing, not an assumption.
observed.no_second_root_or_owner: Zero new 'Babel2 launch trace event/result' lines appear anywhere in this sequence. `installBabel2Root` is guarded by `babel2NavigationController == nil` (iOS/SceneDelegate.swift), so a scene that never disconnected cannot get a second root installed; the trace confirms no rootInstalled/sceneConfigurationSelected event fired again.
observed.route_preserved: Screenshot 3 (after returning to foreground) still shows the Daring Fireball article list, same articles, same scroll position as screenshot 1. The only pixel difference between the two full screenshots is the transient system status-bar affordance '◄ Settings' that iOS itself draws for a moment after an app switch; the content below the status bar is unchanged.

part_1_background_foreground_pass.conclusion: Backgrounding via a real app switch (not just a screenshot no-op) and returning to foreground stays on the exact same Babel2 root/session/route with zero legacy involvement. This covers the 'reconnect' half of A10 for the case where the scene is merely backgrounded, not disconnected.

command_or_steps: `xcrun simctl terminate <udid> com.wenbopan.NetNewsWire.iOS-DEBUG` on the still-running PID 60005.
part_2_termination_does_not_exercise_sce.observed: The captured log shows only OS/network teardown noise (connections being cancelled/deallocated as the process dies) — no 'Babel2 external action'/'Babel2 launch trace' line, and specifically no 'sceneDidDisconnect.babel2' teardown log that `SceneDelegate.sceneDidDisconnect(_:)` would emit via `appDelegate.recordTeardown(...)`.
part_2_termination_does_not_exercise_sce.interpretation: `xcrun simctl terminate` sends a hard kill signal at the process level; it does not go through UIKit's normal scene-disconnect lifecycle the way swiping an app away in the App Switcher does. This is a limitation of the test tool, not evidence that `sceneDidDisconnect` is broken — the existing Babel2FeedReaderTests/Babel2BoundaryTests unit-test suite already exercises `sceneDidDisconnect`/`tearDown()` directly (30-cycle assertions referenced in STATUS.md A11 notes) and that remains the applicable evidence for the teardown code path itself.
part_2_termination_does_not_exercise_sce.conclusion: This scenario does NOT close the 'scene disconnect' half of A10. A genuine scene disconnect (user swipes the app away in the App Switcher, or the OS reclaims the scene) has not been reproduced from the command line in this round.

limitations: 只覆盖 Simulator，且只覆盖'后台/前台切换'这一种 reconnect 场景；真正的 scene disconnect（用户在多任务界面把 App 划掉，或系统回收 scene 后再次进入）需要真实交互或真机，本轮命令行手段做不到，仍是 open。也不覆盖 30-cycle 的完整 production 级别重复（那部分现有单元测试已覆盖，见 STATUS.md），本轮只做了 1 次 background→foreground 循环，不是 30 次。
status: 实现进行中/证据待补——后台/前台切换子场景通过（需 root 复审）；scene disconnect/真机 30-cycle 仍缺
